integrity: Proof reduces arbitrarily large richness to exact integer partitions of excess census at most seven. Finite partition table supplies exhaustive mathematical classification; reproducible integer verification is supplementary and does not substitute for the reduction. No independent scientific audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-count comparison at fixed species richness and total census; not an estimator under stochastic sampling. Only first weak disagreement and first strict reversal classified. Source Nagendra (2002) full text unavailable, so equivalent unindexed results remain a literature risk.
title: Sharp census thresholds for Shannon–Simpson evenness rankings
